insideTop.title: New from the foundation up.
insideTop.intro: An East End bungalow with the big work already done: new wiring and breaker box, three-phase power, new plumbing, a new roof, Hardi Plank siding and a foundation that was reworked, leveled and braced. New floors, trim and lighting run from the living room through the dining area to the open kitchen. Out back are a deck off the nook, a fenced yard, a covered patio and a covered space big enough to park under. It has never flooded.

features.caption: Stainless range, vent hood and a marble-look backsplash, with navy cabinets below.
features.title: A kitchen with counter space
features.body: An L-shaped kitchen with navy lower cabinets, white shaker uppers and stone-look counters. The stainless range sits under a chimney hood, and a peninsula with two pendant lights adds seating and prep space.

features.caption: New floors and trim, with windows on two walls and a wide opening to the kitchen.
features.title: One open front room
features.body: The front door opens into a 16 x 13 living room with a tall window and a clerestory window set high on the wall. A wide cased opening leads to the dining area and kitchen, with no doors or steps between them.

tiles.title: Dining area
tiles.body: Room for a table of six, open to the kitchen, with a sputnik-style light centered overhead.

tiles.title: Breakfast bar
tiles.body: Three stools fit under the two pendant lights, with prep space on the kitchen side.

tiles.title: Breakfast nook
tiles.body: Windows on two walls and a door that opens to the deck and the fenced backyard.

tiles.title: Pantry
tiles.body: Tucked just off the kitchen, with room for dry goods, snacks and the small appliances.

introMore: The primary bedroom has a vaulted ceiling and a painted beam.

features.caption: New tile, a lit mirror and a dark vanity with double sinks.
features.title: Primary bath
features.body: Double sinks in a marble-look top, a navy vanity with drawers and a wide LED mirror. The walk-in shower has a rain head and a handheld sprayer.

features.caption: Two corner windows, new carpet and a ceiling fan.
features.title: Second bedroom
features.body: A front corner room with windows on two walls, new carpet and a ceiling fan. The larger of the two secondary bedrooms; it shares the hall bath.

tiles.title: Third bedroom
tiles.body: Between the second bedroom and the primary, with a large window, a reach-in closet and new carpet. Set up here as a home office with a desk and shelves.

tiles.title: Walk-in shower
tiles.body: Marble-look tile runs floor to ceiling over a pebble tile floor, with a long niche for shampoo and soap and a rain head above. A glass door keeps cleanup simple.

tiles.title: Closet
tiles.body: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower in the primary closet, with hanging rods on both sides and shelves above. The tower stays with the house.

back.title: The backyard and the bath.

feature.body: The covered structure is 14 x 24, with heavy wood posts, a solid roof and a concrete floor. Park under it, set up a workshop on the three-phase power, or use it as an outdoor lounge beside the patio and the yard.
